name: Aman Gupta
thesis: I build and study language models, foundation models, AI agents, and recommender systems. Shipping to millions and doing research that holds up are the same job.
meta_description: Aman Gupta is a Principal Machine Learning Engineer at Nubank, working on LLM alignment, AI agents, efficient inference, and large-scale recommender systems.
about: I lead company-wide research on AI agents, foundation models, and LLMs at Nubank, where the systems we build serve {{ profile.customer_scale }} customers. My work sits at the intersection of large-scale optimization, deep learning, and language models, much of it in long-running collaborations with Keerthi Selvaraj, Rahul Mazumder, and Natesh Pillai.

Before Nubank I spent six years at LinkedIn, most recently as a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer and Senior Manager in Core AI, where I led the team compressing and distilling LinkedIn's ranking foundation model and drove large-scale optimization across Feed, Ads, and Jobs. Earlier I was a Senior Machine Learning Research Scientist at Apple and a software engineer at Amazon. I studied at Carnegie Mellon and BITS Pilani.
venues_note: Published at ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, KDD, WWW, CIKM, and EMNLP.
